Common questions
Can Fast Scheduler post to groups?

Fast Scheduler schedules to channels, which is the broadcast use case it is built for. For community discussion, create a channel with a linked discussion group — comments there are tracked in your statistics.
What is a discussion group in Telegram?
A group linked to your channel in channel settings. Every channel post gets a comment thread in that group, giving readers a place to reply without polluting the channel feed.
